title: Waxpol Ecosaver Car & Bike Shampoo Concentrate 5L with Microfiber Cloth & Ecosaver Sponge for Bucket, Foam & Snow Foam Wash
description: ECONOMICAL: Waxpol Ecosaver Shampoo is a THICK CONCENTRATE Shampoo that gives Powerful Cleaning Action Easily Removes All Dirt, Grime, Grease, Oils, Road Film, Bugs and Pollutants etc. 1 Litre makes 200 Litres of wash solution. HEAVY FOAM (BUCKET, FOAM GUN OR SNOW FOAM) – Whether you are washing with a wash mitt and bucket, a foam gun or foam Snow foam connected to your pressure washer, ECOSAVER CAR SHAMPOO IS THE RIGHT CAR WASH LIQUID to deliver loads of foam and suds to get a great wash SAFE: Ecosaver Car Shampoo is PH BALANCED and gentle on all exterior automobile parts like paint, clear coat, polished metals, glass, and plastic trim. SAFE ON HANDS. It's safe on waxes, sealants and ceramic coatings too! Derived from NATURAL and BIODEGREBLE INGREDIENTS; free from the harsh sodium and sulphates found in many shampoo products. Free from harsh detergents. VERSATILE USE: ADVANCED FORMULA that wash tough dirt and grime and removes it safely without harming any wax or paint coatings. Safe for all vehicle's, including trucks, Car, motorcycles, boats, RV's, Office, Yort , Home outdoor furniture. Can be used for bathroom and kitchen tiles, floors. Can be used in old silverware or metal jewellery and other such precious metals as shampoo content less detergent so it is less reactive. EASY TO USE: Just add two cap full (20ml) of CAR SHAMPOO CONCENTRATE into bucket with 4 litres of clean water & mix property. Apply this solution to car surface with clean sponge/towel or foam gun & spread it. Rinse the surface thoroughly with clean water & dry the surface using clean cloth towel Includes Premium Microfiber Cloth: Comes with a high-quality microfiber cloth (Size: 40 x 40 cm, GSM: 350, Color: Grey) for smooth, streak-free polishing.
